The MPON reports the meter operation to the GO. The GO examines the application of the MPON. The GO rejects the application of the MPON or the GO confirmes the application of the MPON. The GO informs the MPOO about the registration confirmation of the MPON. The GO informs the MSPO about the registration confirmation of the MPON. The MPON and the MPOO perform the equipment acquisition and / or equipment changes. The MPON informs the GO about the failure of the entire process or the MPON informs the GO about the successful completion of the entire process. The GO informs the MPON about the failure of the overall transaction by deadline if after a maximum time limit no message of the MPON is present at the GO. If the MPON informs the GO about the failure of the entire process, the GO confirms the failure of the assignment to the MPON. If the MPON informs the GO about the successful completion of the overall process, the GO assigns the MPON. The GO confirms the assignment to the MPON. The GO informs the MPOO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON or the GO informs the MPOO about the assignment of the MPON. The GO informs the MSPO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON or the GO informs the MSPO about the assignment of the MPON. The GO informs the SP about the assignment of the MPON.

    <messageFlow id="mf_report_success" name="Process Completion" sourceRef="task_mpon_report_success" targetRef="event_go_success_rec" />

    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_assign_mpon" name="Assignment Confirmation" sourceRef="task_go_confirm_assign" targetRef="event_mpon_assign_confirmed" />

      <outgoing>seq_go_5</outgoing>

      <outgoing>seq_go_fail_rec_out</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_go_fail" />

      <incoming>seq_go_fail_rec_out</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_6</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="task_go_inform_mpoo_fail" name="Inform MPOO about Failure of Assignment">
      <incoming>seq_go_6</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_7</outgoing>

      <outgoing>seq_go_fail_end</outgoing>

      <incoming>seq_go_fail_end</incoming>

    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_go_success_rec" name="Success Message Received">

      <outgoing>seq_go_succ_rec_out</outgoing>

      <outgoing>seq_go_succ_end</outgoing>
    </task>

    <endEvent id="end_go_assigned" name="MPON Successfully Assigned">
      <incoming>seq_go_succ_end</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows GO -->

    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_rejected" name="No" sourceRef="gw_go_exam_decision" targetRef="task_go_reject" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="gw_go_exam_decision" targetRef="task_go_confirm_app" />

    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_4" sourceRef="task_go_inform_mpoo_reg" targetRef="task_go_inform_mspo_reg" />

             targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">

  <collaboration id="collaboration_mpo">
    <participant id="participant_go" name="Grid Operator (GO)" processRef="process_go" />
    <participant id="participant_mpon" name="New Metering Point Operator (MPON)" processRef="process_mpon" />
    <participant id="participant_mpoo" name="Old Metering Point Operator (MPOO)" />
    <participant id="participant_mspo" name="Meter Service Provider (MSPO)" />
    <participant id="participant_sp" name="Supplier (SP)" />

    <messageFlow id="mf_report_meter_op" name="Report Meter Operation" sourceRef="task_mpon_report_op" targetRef="start_go_report_rec" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_app_rejected" name="Application Rejected" sourceRef="task_go_reject" targetRef="event_mpon_app_rejected" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_reg_mpon" name="Registration Confirmation" sourceRef="task_go_confirm_app" targetRef="event_mpon_reg_confirmed" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_reg_mpoo" name="Registration Confirmation" sourceRef="task_go_inform_mpoo_reg" targetRef="participant_mpoo" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_reg_mspo" name="Registration Confirmation" sourceRef="task_go_inform_mspo_reg" targetRef="participant_mspo" />
    
    <messageFlow id="mf_report_failure" name="Process Failure" sourceRef="task_mpon_report_failure" targetRef="event_go_failure_rec" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_report_success" name="Process Completion" sourceRef="task_mpon_report_success" targetRef="event_go_success_rec" />
    
    <messageFlow id="mf_timeout_failure" name="Transaction Failure by Deadline" sourceRef="task_go_inform_timeout" targetRef="event_mpon_timeout" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_fail_mpon" name="Confirmation of Failure" sourceRef="task_go_confirm_failure" targetRef="event_mpon_failure_confirmed" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_fail_mpoo" name="Assignment Failure" sourceRef="task_go_inform_mpoo_fail" targetRef="participant_mpoo" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_fail_mspo" name="Assignment Failure" sourceRef="task_go_inform_mspo_fail" targetRef="participant_mspo" />
    
    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_assign_mpon" name="Assignment Confirmation" sourceRef="task_go_confirm_assign" targetRef="event_mpon_assign_confirmed" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_assign_mpoo" name="Assignment Notification" sourceRef="task_go_inform_mpoo_assign" targetRef="participant_mpoo" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_assign_mspo" name="Assignment Notification" sourceRef="task_go_inform_mspo_assign" targetRef="participant_mspo" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_assign_sp" name="Assignment Notification" sourceRef="task_go_inform_sp_assign" targetRef="participant_sp" />
  </collaboration>

    <startEvent id="start_go_report_rec" name="Meter Operation Report Received">
      <outgoing>seq_go_1</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_start_go" />
    </startEvent>

    <task id="task_go_examine" name="Examine Application of MPON">
      <incoming>seq_go_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_2</outgoing>
    </task>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gw_go_exam_decision" name="Application Approved?">
      <incoming>seq_go_2</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_rejected</outgoing>
      <outgoing>seq_go_approved</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <task id="task_go_reject" name="Reject Application of MPON">
      <incoming>seq_go_rejected</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_to_end_reject</outgoing>
    </task>

    <endEvent id="end_go_rejected" name="Application Rejected">
      <incoming>seq_go_to_end_reject</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <task id="task_go_confirm_app" name="Confirm Application of MPON">
      <incoming>seq_go_approved</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_3</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="task_go_inform_mpoo_reg" name="Inform MPOO about Registration Confirmation">
      <incoming>seq_go_3</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_4</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="task_go_inform_mspo_reg" name="Inform MSPO about Registration Confirmation">
      <incoming>seq_go_4</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_5</outgoing>
    </task>

    <eventBasedGateway id="gw_go_await_completion" name="Await MPON Response">
      <incoming>seq_go_5</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_to_timer</outgoing>
      <outgoing>seq_go_to_fail_rec</outgoing>
      <outgoing>seq_go_to_succ_rec</outgoing>
    </eventBasedGateway>

    <!-- Branch 1: Timeout -->
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_go_timer" name="Maximum Time Limit Exceeded">
      <incoming>seq_go_to_timer</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_timer_out</outgoing>
      <timerEventDefinition id="ted_go_timer" />
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <task id="task_go_inform_timeout" name="Inform MPON about Failure by Deadline">
      <incoming>seq_go_timer_out</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_timeout_end</outgoing>
    </task>

    <endEvent id="end_go_timeout" name="Failed by Deadline">
      <incoming>seq_go_timeout_end</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <!-- Branch 2: Process Failure Reported -->
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_go_failure_rec" name="Failure Message Received">
      <incoming>seq_go_to_fail_rec</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_fail_rec_out</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_go_fail" />
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <task id="task_go_confirm_failure" name="Confirm Failure of Assignment to MPON">
      <incoming>seq_go_fail_rec_out</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_6</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="task_go_inform_mpoo_fail" name="Inform MPOO about Failure of Assignment">
      <incoming>seq_go_6</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_7</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="task_go_inform_mspo_fail" name="Inform MSPO about Failure of Assignment">
      <incoming>seq_go_7</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_fail_end</outgoing>
    </task>

    <endEvent id="end_go_failed" name="Process Terminated with Failure">
      <incoming>seq_go_fail_end</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <!-- Branch 3: Process Success Reported -->
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_go_success_rec" name="Success Message Received">
      <incoming>seq_go_to_succ_rec</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_succ_rec_out</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_go_succ" />
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <task id="task_go_assign_mpon" name="Assign MPON">
      <incoming>seq_go_succ_rec_out</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_8</outgoing>

      <incoming>seq_go_8</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_9</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="task_go_inform_mpoo_assign" name="Inform MPOO about Assignment of MPON">
      <incoming>seq_go_9</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_10</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="task_go_inform_mspo_assign" name="Inform MSPO about Assignment of MPON">
      <incoming>seq_go_10</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_11</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="task_go_inform_sp_assign" name="Inform SP about Assignment of MPON">
      <incoming>seq_go_11</incoming>
      <outgoing>seq_go_succ_end</outgoing>
    </task>

    <endEvent id="end_go_assigned" name="MPON Successfully Assigned">
      <incoming>seq_go_succ_end</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows GO -->
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_1" sourceRef="start_go_report_rec" targetRef="task_go_examine" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_2" sourceRef="task_go_examine" targetRef="gw_go_exam_decision" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_rejected" name="No" sourceRef="gw_go_exam_decision" targetRef="task_go_reject" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="gw_go_exam_decision" targetRef="task_go_confirm_app" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_to_end_reject" sourceRef="task_go_reject" targetRef="end_go_rejected" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_3" sourceRef="task_go_confirm_app" targetRef="task_go_inform_mpoo_reg" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_4" sourceRef="task_go_inform_mpoo_reg" targetRef="task_go_inform_mspo_reg" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_5" sourceRef="task_go_inform_mspo_reg" targetRef="gw_go_await_completion" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_to_timer" sourceRef="gw_go_await_completion" targetRef="event_go_timer" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_to_fail_rec" sourceRef="gw_go_await_completion" targetRef="event_go_failure_rec" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_to_succ_rec" sourceRef="gw_go_await_completion" targetRef="event_go_success_rec" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_timer_out" sourceRef="event_go_timer" targetRef="task_go_inform_timeout" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_timeout_end" sourceRef="task_go_inform_timeout" targetRef="end_go_timeout" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_fail_rec_out" sourceRef="event_go_failure_rec" targetRef="task_go_confirm_failure" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_6" sourceRef="task_go_confirm_failure" targetRef="task_go_inform_mpoo_fail" />
    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_7" sourceRef="task_go_inform_mpoo_fail" targetRef="task_go_inform_mspo_fail" />

    <sequenceFlow id="seq_go_succ_end" sourceRef="task_go_inform_sp_assign" targetRef="end_go_assigned" />
